scope: Visual concept development and refinement after the user rejected the V1 aesthetic.

baseline.assessment: User said the design lacked a sense of design. Prior technical checks do not establish aesthetic quality.

skillChange: Turn subject-specific cues into visual composition, compare real key pages when direction is open, extend the concept into content pages, and separate technical checks from aesthetic judgment.

directions.A: River screenprint, cobalt/paper palette and large sans-serif title; expanded to six pages by the author.
directions.B: Large vertical Chinese typography and narrow garden photography; cover and itinerary prototype retained.

asset.usage: concept illustration, not documentary photography or a geographic map

visualInspection: Mobile cover and Yangzhou page viewed.

limits: Author assessment is not user endorsement.
No independent aesthetic benchmark or blind evaluation.
No evidence of a general improvement guarantee across design tasks.
